title: Global scalar extension commutes with the actual tensor localization construction
statement: Let (C,J,O) be a small commutative ringed site, A its ring of global sections, and f:Fin r to Gamma(O) a finite list. Let T be the actual global scalar-extension functor [def-weil-pbc-global-section-scalar-extension]. Form the actual augmented tensor extended Cech complex [def-weil-pbc-ringed-extended-cech] over A on its one-point ring site, and over O on C. There is an isomorphism from the latter complex to T of the former whose composite with T of the ring augmentation followed by the fixed multiplication T(A) to O is exactly the existing tensor augmentation. This only compares the two actual tensor constructions; it contains no arbitrary augmented complex, ordered-coordinate equivalences or alternating differential hypotheses.

Induct on the length of the list. For length zero use the complex unit isomorphism and the unit inverse identity. For a successor, tensor the first-factor comparison with the induction isomorphism and compose with the complex tensorator. Tensorator naturality applied to the two projections, the monoidal left-unit coherence, and tensor composition show that its composite with the extended augmentation is exactly the recursive target augmentation. This is proved as augmented_tensor_map and the final Lean induction.

lean.statement:
theorem ringFamilyGlobalExtension_tensor_iso
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    (O : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u})
    (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → (O.obj ⋙ forget CommRingCat).sections) :
    ∃ e : (ringedExtendedCech O r f).1 ≅ ringFamilyGlobalExtensionComplex O
        (ringTensorCech (ringFamilyGlobalRing O) r (ringFamilyGlobalList O r f)).1,
      e.hom ≫ ringFamilyGlobalExtensionAugmentation O
        (ringTensorCech (ringFamilyGlobalRing O) r (ringFamilyGlobalList O r f)).2 =
          (ringedExtendedCech O r f).2
